First, 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 5 days → total added = 341 days.  

Start date: 1092-04-24 (Gregorian).  
Add 341 days:  
April 24 → April 30 = 6 days (remain 335 days)  
May 31 days → 335 - 31 = 304  
June 30 → 304 - 30 = 274  
July 31 → 274 - 31 = 243  
August 31 → 243 - 31 = 212  
September 30 → 212 - 30 = 182  
October 31 → 182 - 31 = 151  
November 30 → 151 - 30 = 121  
December 31 → 121 - 31 = 90  
January 1093 (31 days) → 90 - 31 = 59  
February 1093 (28 days, not leap year because 1093 not divisible by 4) → 59 - 28 = 31  
March 31 days → 31 - 31 = 0 → end of March 31.  

So new date = 1093-03-31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1093-03-31
